messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert INC-83456 fired — west-eu gpu-pool queue saturation >90% sustained for 5m. Token throttling observed. https://pd.example/INC-83456
Mira (oncall): I'm on pager. Spawning triage thread here. /whoami oncall
Sanjay: Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with quota_limit, then nodes flapping NotReady after kernel OOMs. Suspect driver churn after last driver rollout.
Jamal: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=west-eu-gpu -o wide` -> 6/18 NotReady, 2 flapping. rpq.queue_length{pool=west-eu-gpu}=3892.
Ellie: Support seeing increased embedding timeouts; several customers complaining about high tail latency, not 5xxs yet. I flagged corpA and scaleLabs.
Ops-Lead: Assign infra. @InfraBot pull driver deployment history and recent kernel updates.
InfraBot: Audit: driver-package v526 rolled to west-eu ~1.5h ago (deploy dp-7832). No kernel update recorded in same window.
Sanjay: Dmesg snippets showing Xid 79 and OOM kills. ```
[ 4021.123456] NVRM: Xid 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 4021.123789] kernel: Out of memory: kill process 6142 (model_runtime)
[ 4021.124000] kubelet: NodeStatus: NotReady
```
Mira (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) enable CPU fallback for non-critical embedding traffic, 2) cordon & drain flapping nodes, 3) request emergency capacity increase. I'll start (1) now.
AutoscalerBot: Route change applied: embeddings/* -> cpu-embed-fallback (canary). ~19% traffic shifted.
Jamal: Queue at peak 3892; after fallback it dropped to ~2140. Starting cordon/drain of top 3 flappers. Some pods stuck Terminating due to GPU driver hooks, doing force-delete where safe.
Ops-Lead: Pause autoscaler to avoid thrash while we remediate. Mira, apply autoscaler.pause label.
Mira (oncall): Applied `autoscaler.pause=true` to west-eu pool.
CapacityTeam: Emergency quota request QREQ-10021 created for +25% west-eu capacity. Manual approval path triggered.
Jamal: Tried provisioning reserved spare nodes; two came up, one triggered kernel panic during kube-proxy restart and rebooted.
Sanjay: Kernel logs: ```
[ 4050.001000] NVRM: GPU 0000:af:00.0: PID 7011: oom killed
[ 4050.001500] NVRM: Xid 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 4050.002000] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Out of memory
```
Ops-Lead: v526 looks correlated. Plan: rollback driver to r515 on a canary node, soak 30m, then staged rollback if no Xid. Jamal please reimage canary.
Jamal: Canary reimage with r515 complete. 35m soak, no Xid observed. Ready to roll batch 1 (3 nodes) with staged uncordon and 30% spare margin.
Sanjay: Recommend keep autoscaler paused until at least 50% of nodes are on r515 or we have 30% spare headroom. Also adjust autoscaler hysteresis to reduce oscillation.
Ellie: Customer comms drafted: "We're investigating increased latency for embeddings. Temporary CPU fallback active. We're rolling a safe rollback of GPU drivers; will notify before cross-region routing." Sending to corpA/scaleLabs for FYI & consent for cross-region if needed.
Mira (oncall): Rolling batch 1 rollback now. Jamal coordinate; Ops-Lead hold autoscaler paused.
Jamal: Batch 1 completed, uncordoned. No flaps in 20m. Queue decreased from 2140 -> 480. Evicted pods rescheduled.
AutoscalerBot: Autoscaler remains paused. Current queue: 420. Fallback handling ~22% of embed traffic.
Mira (oncall): Rolling batch 2 with same parameters. If stable after batch 2, we'll resume autoscaler with conservative caps.
Jamal: Batch 2 rollback done; one node required reimage after stuck driver module unload. All good now. Queue trending down to 160.
CapacityTeam: Manual quota review still pending; billing hold preventing auto-approve.
Mira (oncall): Resume autoscaler with conservative ramp: min=3, max=12, step=1, cooldown=5m.
AutoscalerBot: Autoscaler resumed with conservative policy. No immediate thrash observed.
Ellie: Sent customer update: mitigation in place, rollback progressing, expected recovery window ~60m. Support updated incident status and notified top affected customers.
Ops-Lead: Action items captured: 1) full rollback across pool and canary verification, 2) RCA for v526 roll and gating, 3) update autoscaler alert thresholds to avoid thrash when soft quota hit, 4) streamline emergency quota escalation flow with oncall-friendly approvals.
Mira (oncall): PD INC-83456 will remain open until steady state (queue <200 and zero node flaps for 30m). Creating incident doc and assigning postmortem owners.
IncidentBot: INC-83456 updated: owners Mira, Sanjay, Jamal. Severity P1 -> monitoring.
Ellie: Final check: 30m steady window observed, queue 85, no node flaps in 40m. Preparing postmortem draft and customer summary. Thanks all. :heart:
Ops-Lead: Close loop: add driver preflight stress tests to release gating and ensure quota alerting triggers before autoscaler thrash.
Mira (oncall): Will file follow-ups and RFC for driver rollout gating. Marking recovery -> monitoring.
